::: {#hero-heading}
Welcome!

I’m Zhiqiang Wang, a Xingnong Young Scholar at the College of Economics and Management, China Agricultural University. I recived my Ph.D. in Economics from the School of Economics, Peking University in 2026. I received my Bachelor of Economics from the School of Economics, Peking University in 2021.  

My research interests include the economics of climate change and environmental economics, and I also have a strong interest in quantitative economic history. Currently, I focus on how climate shocks influence the adaptation of industrial sector. 

Welcome discussions and collaborations.




:::
